note: Datasets with no real coverage in this region, per CONSTITUTION.md section 1.1. The client renders these as unknown rather than substituting a guess.

checked.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2023 sub-county population estimates, 2020 Census count
checked.basis: every settlement in settlements.json carries a non-null population and a populationSource citation, so no row takes the population: null path in classifySettlement
checked.method: computed from the deployed settlements.json, not transcribed

supersedes.why: This file previously listed eleven Colorado Front Range places - Evergreen, West Pleasant View, Holly Hills, Tolland, Central City, Leyden, Zuni, Derby, Western Hills, Gold Hill and Gunbarrel - as having no population. That was a stopgap Colorado region fetched from OpenStreetMap, not the deployed Ohio River Valley region. None of the eleven is a settlement in this region, so every entry was false here. tools/fetch-world-data.mjs no longer writes this file into public/world/: it is the OpenStreetMap comparison fetch, and its output now goes to public/world/osm/, which the client never loads. See clients/campaign/public/world/DATA-MANIFEST.md section 4.1.
